Container.Name: Airbridge
Container.Overview:
Airbridge - Anything → Everywhere
Bridge DLNA/UPnP audio streams to AirPlay speakers and Chromecast devices. Create virtual DLNA renderers that forward audio to your smart speakers.
Perfect for streaming from Music Assistant, Plex, Roon, or any DLNA-compatible media server to: • AirPlay devices (HomePods, Sonos, Apple TV, Juke Audio) • Chromecast devices (Google Nest, Chromecast Audio)
Features: • Web-based admin interface with real-time status • Auto-discovery of AirPlay and Chromecast devices • Create and manage multiple bridges • Live playback status via WebSocket • Volume control support • Persistent configuration
IMPORTANT: Set AIRBRIDGE_PORT if you need a port other than 8200.
Requires host network mode for mDNS device discovery.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage for database and configuration

Config.Name: Web Admin Port
Config.Description: Port for the web admin interface. Change if 8200 conflicts with another service.
